outcomes: A service can use an in-memory cache with the cache-aside call shape
The built-in memory cache never serves a value after its expiration deadline
A service can bound entry count and observe misses, hits, and capacity evictions
nonGoals: Providing distributed cache coherence or a network cache backend
Promising strict compatibility between every pre-1.0 minor release

requirements.text: Positive TTLs in MemoryCache expire on one deadline, zero TTLs do not expire.
A positive MaxEntries bound evicts capacity entries without evicting merely because an existing key is overwritten; capacity evictions are counted separately from deletion and expiration.
Set and Get do not expose shared mutable byte slices between callers and cache state.
